notes: 1934 flora of Mani: Latin binomials with authorities, Greek vernacular names ('κ. ἀσπροπικροπάνι') and localities, plus polytonic prose; the crops read correctly in both scripts (1-40). The 'column-crossing' lines are species rows with a locality column to the right (21-25, 29, 30, 33, 36-40) and the labels reproduce both cells correctly, so they are not merges of running text. Only one Cyrillic 'к' for Greek 'κ' (32) and the 31 crop is cut at the right edge where a library stamp intrudes.
